name: What maintenance is required for custom built-ins?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for custom built-ins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for custom built-ins primarily involves routine cleaning appropriate for the specific materials and finishes chosen, such as dusting and wiping with a damp cloth for painted or stained wood. Avoid harsh abrasives or chemical cleaners that could damage the surface. For any moving parts like drawer slides or hinges, periodic checks and light lubrication may be beneficial to ensure continued smooth operation. AKN Design Group uses durable, high-quality materials and finishes to ensure your built-ins provide lasting impressions and withstand daily use with minimal upkeep, reflecting our commitment to superior craftsmanship in all our projects.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance for custom built-ins involves routine cleaning with appropriate products for their materials and finishes. Periodic checks of moving parts ensure longevity.
